CODING ASSIGNMENT U1A1 
Section A 
Answer the following questions [1 mark if you answer all the below questions]: 
1. How many samples are there? 
Answer: 414 
 
2. How many input variables are there? 
Answer: 6 
 
3. Which column is the output variable (target outcome)? 
Answer: Y house price of unit area 
 
4. What does each of the input columns mean? 
          Answer: X1 shows the year & months in which the transaction of land 
was done. X2 contains data about how old the houses in transaction 
are in terms of number of years. X3 variable consist of the distance 
of the sold houses from nearest MRT (mass rapid transit) station 
whereas X4 shows the number of convenience stores in the living 
circle around the house. 
 
Section B 
1. Understanding the dataset [4 marks]. Which input variable do you think is 
better in predicting the output / target variable?

Answer: X3 (distance to the nearest MRT station). Because it shows stronger 
correlation with the target variable compared to the other input variables. 
 
2. Write code to find out how many samples are there in total in this dataset? 
        [1 mark] 
 
 
 
3. What is the train test split ratio you have chosen? [1 Mark] 
Answer: 1/4 (25% - 75%)

4. Evaluate the linear regression model by computing the MAE, MSE and Mean 
Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). [3 marks]

5. What are the 3 new things you learned after completing this assignment? 
Answer: 
 To evaluate input variable that is better for predictions. 
 To plot multiple charts without writing codes for each. 
 I learned about MAPE.
